title: Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist
description:
Facility: Baylor Scott and White Hospital- College Station, TX

Department: Catheterization Lab

Shift/Status: Full Time, 40 hours/ week

Schedule: 10 hour shifts x4 days/week, self-scheduling

Call Requirement: 6 week schedule, anywhere between 10-13 days, minimum of 1 weekend: Fri-Sun

Catheterization Lab Specifics:

Patient Population: All cardiac patients, pacemakers, MI’s. 18 years old and up

# of beds: 3 cath labs: 7 pre/post rooms

Patient Ratios: 1:1, case by case basis

Description - External

About Us

Here at Baylor Scott & White Health we promote the well-being of all individuals, families, and communities. Baylor Scott and White is the largest not-for-profit healthcare system in Texas that empowers you to live well.

Our Core Values are:

  • We serve faithfully by doing what's right with a joyful heart.
  • We never settle by constantly striving for better.
  • We are in it together by supporting one another and those we serve.
  • We make an impact by taking initiative and delivering exceptional experience.

Benefits

Our benefits are designed to help you live well no matter where you are on your journey. For full details on coverage and eligibility, visit the Baylor Scott & White Benefits Hub to explore our offerings, which may include:

  • Immediate eligibility for health and welfare benefits
  • 401(k) savings plan with dollar-for-dollar match up to 5%
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • PTO accrual beginning Day 1

Note: Benefits may vary based upon position type and/or level.

Job Summary

The Cardiovascular Invasive Specialist, under general supervision, helps Physicians during catheterization and electrophysiology lab procedures. Prepares room and equipment, instructs patients, monitors patient's condition, and provides routine and emergency care during procedures. Contributes to the orientation and training of other team members. Helps in daily, monthly, and quarterly quality control initiatives through auditing and reporting.

Essential Functions of the Role

  • Helps Physicians with arteriograms/catheterizations, permanent pacemaker implantations, implantable cardiac defibrillators, diagnostic and interventional, peripheral and coronary, interventional and thrombolytic therapy.
  • Follows national and state radiation protection regulations for patients, self, and staff. Provides emergency procedures like CPR and defibrillation as needed.
  • Performs pre and post-procedure care and monitoring.
  • Orients patients for catheterization or electrophysiology procedures.
  • Answers related questions to make patient relaxed.
  • Monitors patient’s ECG, pressures, temperature and impendences while in Electrophysiology Lab; notifies physician of variances.
  • Helps in running RF/Cryo ablation systems, 3D mapping, and records other procedural documentation.
  • Manages and maintains images that may include stenosis testing, formatting and processing on both cardiac and peripheral cases.
  • Helps in procedure rooms and collects registry and quality data on appropriate forms.
  • Gathers catheterization data and prepares procedure reports.
  • Prepares and maintains sterile fields for Lab procedures.
  • Orders and maintains inventory of procedure room supplies.
  • Ensures procedure rooms are adequately stocked and equipment has not expired.
  • Coordinates and/or audits resources during yearly inventories.
  • Performs routine calibration and maintenance of complex equipment; notifies appropriate team members for fixes.
  • Help in the orientation and training of new staff and students or extra duties as established by supervisor/manager.
  • Oversees some level of quality control monitoring, such as NPSG auditing, turnaround times, performance improvement initiatives. (Daily, monthly and/or quarterly).
  • Participates in mutual governance, department, hospital, or professional organizations and committees. This includes LEAN initiatives, NOBLE, 5S projects, inter-departmental committees, professional organization participation, and QC assurance with managers.
  • Oversees the committee as requested.
  • Transports patients to and from procedural area.
  • Demonstrates good customer service skills.

Key Success Factors

  • Education and/or Experience requirements (must meet one of the following): - Associate's degree in a related field, or - Completion of US military training program and experience equivalent to an Associate's degree, or - 2 years of related cardiovascular lab experience.
  • Must be available for On Call response requirements per facility/department policy.
  • Knowledge and ability to apply complex invasive cardiac and vascular values, instrumentation and techniques.
  • Knowledge of cardiovascular anatomy and physiology.

Belonging Statement

We believe that all people should feel welcomed, valued and supported.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • EDUCATION - Associate's or 2 years of work experience above the minimum qualification
  • EXPERIENCE - Less than 1 Year of Experience

CERTIFICATION/LICENSE/REGISTRATION -

  • ACLS (ACLS): ACLS within 30 days of hire/transfer.
  • Basic Life Support (BLS): BLS within 30 days of hire/transfer.
  • ARRT-R Radiography (ARRT-R), Cert Cardiac Device Spec (CCDS), Cert EP Specialist (CEPS), Medical Radiologic Tech (MRT), Reg Cardio Electrophysiology (RCES), Reg Cardiovascular Invasive Sp (RCIS): Must meet one of the following: American Registry of Radiologic Tech (ARRT-R) and MRT through TX Medical Board, or Cardio Invasive Spec (RCIS), or Reg Cardiac Electro Spec (RCES), or Cert Electro Spec (CEPS), or Cert Cardiac Device Spec (CCDS).

title: Consultant Neurocritical Care / Neurointensive Care - Abu Dhabi
description:
Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Consultant in Neurocritical Care to join our Intensive Care Unit in Abu Dhabi.

The successful candidate will provide specialist critical care management for patients with severe neurological and neurosurgical conditions, working closely with Neurology, Neurosurgery, Emergency Medicine, Stroke, Anesthesiology and other multidisciplinary teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide consultant-level care for critically ill neurological and neurosurgical patients.
  • Manage patients with:
    • Acute ischemic and hemorrhagic stroke
    • Subarachnoid and intracerebral hemorrhage
    • Traumatic brain injury
    • Status epilepticus
    • Acute neuromuscular and neurological emergencies
    • Brain tumors and postoperative neurosurgical complications
    • Cerebral edema and raised intracranial pressure
    • CNS infections and other severe neurological disorders
  • Manage airway, ventilation, hemodynamic instability and multisystem critical illness in neurocritical patients.
  • Participate in neurological monitoring and management of intracranial pressure and cerebral perfusion.
  • Support stroke and neurovascular pathways, including post-thrombectomy and post-neurosurgical critical care.
  • Collaborate with Neurosurgery, Neurology, Neuroradiology, Anesthesiology, Emergency Medicine and Rehabilitation teams.
  • Participate in multidisciplinary neurocritical care and ICU meetings.
  • Provide leadership in the development and implementation of neurocritical care protocols and pathways.
  • Participate in ICU rounds, emergency response and on-call services.
  • Supervise and mentor ICU physicians, residents, fellows and other clinical staff.
  • Contribute to clinical research, education, quality improvement and patient-safety initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate medical records and comply with hospital policies and UAE healthcare regulations.

Qualifications

  • Medical degree from a recognized medical school.
  • Completed accredited postgraduate training in Critical Care Medicine, Neurology, Neurosurgery, Anesthesiology or another relevant specialty.
  • Fellowship or advanced formal training in Neurocritical Care / Neurointensive Care is highly desirable.
  • Recognized Board Certification/Specialist or Consultant qualification in the relevant primary specialty.
  • Valid Department of Health (DoH) Abu Dhabi Consultant license/eligibility.

Required Experience

  • Significant post-specialist experience in an ICU or dedicated Neurocritical Care Unit.
  • Demonstrated experience managing critically ill neurological and neurosurgical patients.
  • Strong experience in acute stroke, intracranial hemorrhage, traumatic brain injury and status epilepticus.
  • Experience with advanced neurological monitoring and neurocritical care protocols is highly desirable.
  • Experience in a tertiary or academic medical center is an advantage.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience in post-thrombectomy and post-neurosurgical critical care.
  • Familiarity with intracranial pressure monitoring and cerebral hemodynamic management.
  • Experience with EEG/continuous EEG interpretation or close collaboration with neurophysiology services.
  • Experience in clinical research, teaching and service development.

Core Competencies

  • Excellent critical care and neurological clinical judgment.
  • Ability to manage complex, high-acuity neurocritical patients.
  • Strong leadership and multidisciplinary teamwork.
  • Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
  • Commitment to evidence-based, patient-centered care.
  • Ability to work effectively in a high-volume tertiary-care environment.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is a Consultant with dedicated Neurocritical Care fellowship or advanced training, substantial experience managing complex neurological emergencies in an ICU setting, and a DoH Abu Dhabi Consultant license or eligibility.

title: Associate Director - Software Engineering
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


About Lilly

At Lilly, everything we do starts with patients. We unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our global team of over 50,000 employees work with urgency and purpose to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. We bring our best to this work because people depend on it. If you're driven by purpose and determined to make a meaningful difference for patients, we invite you to bring your skill and your commitment to Lilly.

About Technology@Lilly

At Lilly, technology is not a support function. It is how a global medicine company operates, innovates, and delivers. Lilly in Bengaluru builds the capabilities that make this possible, cloud platforms, AI systems, and automation at enterprise scale, all in service of a purpose that makes this technology work genuinely distinctive, from advancing drug discovery to enabling connected clinical trials to keeping a global medicine company running at the standard patients deserve.

About Role

The Associate Director - Software Engineering is a technical leader responsible for the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of software and data engineering solutions, with a solid foundation in software and data engineering concepts and a proven track record of leading engineering teams. This role combines deep hands-on technical expertise with people leadership to set direction, grow talent, and deliver scalable, high-quality systems.

The Associate Director - Software Engineering brings a forward-looking view of technology and actively leverages AI in day-to-day engineering work from coding and testing to monitoring and decision-making to raise team efficiency and output. The role serves as the central point of accountability connecting engineering, architecture, product, and leadership to deliver high-impact solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership & Architecture:
    Own the technical vision and architecture for software and data engineering initiatives, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and built to a high engineering bar.
  • Team Leadership & Mentorship:

title: Family Centered Specialist
description:
Mentor South Bay, provides Early Intervention, Applied Behavioral Analysis (ABA), Behavioral Health and Mental Health Outpatient services across Massachusetts and Connecticut. For over 35 years, we’ve provided a collaborative, team-based approach dedicated to helping children, adults, and families reach their fullest potential. If you are passionate about making a difference in the lives of individuals and families, join our mission-driven team and experience a career well lived.



Bilingual Family-Centered Specialist

Program: Children’s Behavioral Health Initiative (CBHI)
Schedule: Primarily afternoons & early evenings; flexible, community-based
Pay: $52k base + overtime eligible + $6,000 sign-on bonus

Bilingual: Candidates must be fluent in Spanish and able to translate session notes from Spanish into English.

About the Role

As a Family Centered Support Specialist, you’ll work directly with children and youth (ages 3–21) and their caregivers in homes and community settings. In partnership with a Family-Centered Clinician (FCC) who creates the treatment plan, you’ll bring that plan to life—coaching caregivers, teaching practical skills, and supporting the family’s ability to thrive together. Also, to work with the Massachusetts Department of Children and Families (DCF), Safe and Stable Family Services helps families achieve the specific goals outlined in their official DCF service plans, preventing out-of-home placements or helping youth transition back home

What You’ll Do

  • Provide hands-on, skills-based support to children/youth and caregivers in home, school, and community settings.

  • Implement the FCC’s treatment plan; reinforce strategies that build daily living, social, and coping skills.

  • Help families navigate resources and maintain stability—particularly those at risk of separation.

  • Maintain a target of 25 productivity (billable) hours per week, typically serving ~2 families per day.

  • Participate in weekly supervision to review progress, troubleshoot barriers, and refine strategies.

  • Document services accurately and on time; communicate regularly with the FCC and care team.

  • Work a schedule that often includes afternoons and early evenings to meet family needs.

“Day in the Life”

  • Review the FCC’s plan and your visit schedule.

  • Meet a caregiver after school to practice behavior-support routines.

  • Coach a teen in the community on communication and problem-solving skills.

  • Check in with the FCC during supervision to adjust approaches and next steps.

  • Complete brief, timely documentation before wrapping up the day.

Qualifications

  • Education: Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a human services field from an accredited institution (Bachelor’s preferred).

  • Experience: At least 1 year working with children, adolescents, or transition-age youth in a clinical or community setting.

  • Valid driver’s license and reliable personal vehicle for local travel.

  • Comfortable working in homes and community settings with a short-term, stabilization focus (typical episode: 9–12 weeks).

title: Senior Director - Market Access Product Manager
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


Product Manager, Market Access


Organization Overview

Lilly is a medicine company turning science into healing to make life better for people around the world. We are the world’s most well-capitalized platform for enabling positive change in human health.


Lilly's Market Access capability plays a crucial role in Lilly’s mission by engaging with the healthcare ecosystem to enable timely and affordable access to Lilly’s medicines. We are the core business team within Lilly’s US commercial organization. We work with pharmacy benefit managers, health plans, healthcare organizations, pharmacies, wholesalers and distributors, states and the federal government to ensure that patients prescribed a Lilly medicine can get better, faster.


The Market Access Strategy & Transformation team is the innovation hub within the pricing, reimbursement, and access function. Our mission is to leverage Lilly’s unique position within the industry to develop and prosecute an innovation agenda that helps Lilly create world-class customer experiences and new healthcare delivery business models.


Responsibilities

The Product Manager, Market Access is a senior director-level position and will be a leader on the commercial innovation team. This person will own the digital innovation and product management agenda for Market Access. The ideal candidate will have experience leveraging product management skills, data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to solve business problems. This role is a business role but requires someone who can be an outstanding collaborator and thought partner with our Tech@Lilly organization. A strong technology background is a must-have; a healthcare background is a nice-to-have. The key job responsibilities will be to:

  • Develop and implement the data and technology transformation agenda and product roadmap(s) for Lilly’s Market Access organization
  • Become an expert in the US healthcare ecosystem; develop and deliver technology products that enhance the experience of patients taking our medicines and drive growth in our business
  • Become an expert in our internal processes; build technology products that support market access & its productivity agenda
  • Understand other components of the U.S. commercial innovation agenda (consumer experience and business model transformation); ensure we have a technology substrate that enables transformative innovation across these domains
  • Collaborate with other leaders across the company to ensure LVA (Lilly Value and Access) alignment with Lilly’s enterprise data strategy
  • Become a thought leader and evangelist within LVA (Lilly Value and Access) on data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and enterprise data strategy

Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical and analytical domain (e.g., computer science, mathematics, engineering, or similar) and 3+ years of relevant experience

Additional Preferences

  • 3-5 years (or more) of relevant experience in tech or tech-adjacent industries
  • State of the art knowledge of data science, machine learning, and artificial intelligence
  • Relevant experience building and/or implementing enterprise data strategies and technology solutions
  • Outstanding communication skills (written and verbal) and proven ability to influence decisions
  • Product management experience
  • Prior experience at a technology company
  • Intellectual curiosity and learning agility
  • Positive contributor to team and organizational culture

Additional Information

  • Travel: 10-25%
  • This position is based at Lilly Technology Center in Indianapolis, IN.

Job Summary

The Monitor Technician monitors, records, interprets, and documents patients' electrocardiograph tracings on telemetry monitors. This position recognizes and reports arrhythmias to medical or nursing staff.

Essential Functions of the Role

  • Operates complex cardiac monitoring systems, including ECG rhythm screens, computerized dysrhythmia detection system, and rhythm printers.
  • Observes and documents ECG monitors following guidelines. Reports necessary information like patient name, room number, cardiac rhythm, dysrhythmia, and life-threatening situations to appropriate staff.
  • Maintains, monitors, cleans equipment and reports any malfunctions to the appropriate Biomed person.
  • Sets up central station. Monitors alarms, troubleshoots false alarms, and corrects improper placement.
  • Helps with rhythm interpretation and dysrhythmia detection. Labels monitor strips to show events like defibrillation, electrical-cardioversion, CPR, and code medication administration.
  • Records information in the patient's log and keeps an accurate, neat account of the patient's cardiac monitoring status during care. Identifies and records the patient's rhythm and changes in rhythm and condition.

Key Success Factors

title: Senior Director, Global Market Research - Immunology
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


**Position is based at our Corporate Center in Indianapolis, IN. Relocation assistance will be provided for qualified candidates**


Company Overview


At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our 50,000+ employees around the world work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We're looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world.


The Customer Insights and Analytics (CIA) organization is Lilly's business-facing insight and analytics capability, uniting Market Research and Analytics into a single, integrated partnership model that helps our business partners make faster, better, more customer-centered decisions.


Position Overview
The Senior Director, Global Market Research owns market research for a global platform and holds the primary business partnership with the platform's global marketing teams. This leader frames what the business needs to learn, sets and prioritizes the platform's research agenda, and interprets findings into one decision-ready narrative for global brand and franchise leadership, representing the customer's perspective (patient, HCP, payer). Analytics is a supporting input, brought in only when a decision requires it: this person can produce basic analysis directly with AI analyst tools and escalates complex or novel analytics to the US Marketing Analytics lead.


This role reports to the Associate Vice President (AVP) – Immunology Strategic Intelligence and partners closely, in a matrixed model, with the US Marketing Analytics lead — the peer who owns the US marketing partnership and analytics, and who calls on this role to conduct research as needed for US business decisions — along with centralized Research Science and the broader analytics and AI/data-foundation teams.


Responsibilities
Global Business Partnership & Market Acumen
● Hold the primary business partnership with the platform's global marketing teams — serving as the relationship owner and trusted advisor on the market-research agenda and representing the voice of the customer alongside the evidence base.
● Act as the main point of contact for the platform's market-research agenda: the place a business question enters, is framed into the right research, and is routed to the right work, at the right time.
● Influence global brand, franchise, and therapeutic area strategy and decision forums, bringing integrated customer insight to the decisions that shape the platform.
● Maintain a deep, current understanding of key customers, platform strategy, portfolio and product priorities, and competitive dynamics, and translate that understanding into clear, decision-ready recommendations.


Team Leadership & Coaching
● Set clear expectations and participate in budget ownership at the platform level — managing the prioritization and allocation of people, time, and research spend across the platform's agenda — within the overall market-research budget the AVP owns for the therapeutic area.
● Model and reinforce a “one team” culture across market research and analytics, reducing duplication of effort and competition for business attention.
● Coach and develop market-research associates, including in matrixed relationships without direct reporting authority, and take accountability for developing talent that advances into broader business or team leadership roles.
● Hold the team accountable for operating in new, optimized ways aligned with the teams agentic strategy.


Learning Agenda Ownership & Framing
● Own the market-research learning plan for the platform (what to learn, why it matters, and in what order) as a continuous, year-round activity, nested within the therapeutic-area-wide intelligence agenda the AVP prioritizes across platforms.
● Frame ambiguous or cross-cutting business questions into the right research approach, deciding what each question needs.
● Prioritize and re-sequence the agenda as new business questions and market developments arise, and help rank the platform's requests within the team's shared backlog.


Market Research Delivery & Insight Synthesis
● Assign market-research associates to the decisions that matter most, providing craft direction and quality oversight across the platform's studies.
● Conduct research for US business needs when requested by the US Marketing Analytics lead — the peer who owns the US marketing partnership — partnering to deliver one integrated point of view.
● Oversee end-to-end delivery — working directly with external research vendors, drawing on centralized Research Science for methods, quality standards, vendor governance, panel management, cross-TA studies, and specialized techniques, and using AI tools to complete the work.
● Think critically and independently about research design and findings, and lead others to do the same, synthesizing insight across qualitative, quantitative, and analytics inputs into one clear, decision-ready narrative.
● Identify where findings agree, conflict, or need reconciliation before they reach senior stakeholders, and coach business partners on how to frame the questions market research is best positioned to answer.


Central Capabilities & AI-Enabled Ways of Working
● Complete research through the right mix of channels — external vendors for most execution, centralized Research Science for methods, standards, vendor governance, panel management, cross-TA work, and specialized techniques, and AI tools for speed and scale — holding framing, judgment, and interpretation in the platform team while shared standards and vendor governance are built once and maintained centrally rather than duplicated per platform.
● Apply AI-enabled methods (synthetic respondents, automated synthesis, predictive and agentic approaches) to speed up early-stage, exploratory, and standard research, reserving human-led primary research for the highest-stakes decisions.
● Leverage human judgment for framing the question, catching a flawed sample, and interpreting results in context — AI informs the decision; it does not make it. Represent the platform's needs in shaping the teams broader AI/agentic roadmap.


Basic Qualifications
● Bachelor's degree.
● 5+ years of experience in market research or a related insight-generating function.


Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.


Additional Skills / Preferences
● MBA or other advanced degree a plus.
● Demonstrated depth in market-research craft (learning-agenda design, qualitative and quantitative methods, launch and tracking research) and working fluency in analytics.
● Experience serving as a primary point of contact for senior business stakeholders, ideally within a matrixed or shared-services organization.
● Skill in framing business questions and synthesizing insight, connecting findings across methods and data sources into a single, coherent business narrative.
● Ability to influence senior individuals and teams, including at the therapeutic area and leadership level, without direct authority.
● Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, competing priorities, and complex, matrixed stakeholder landscapes.
● Strong track record partnering closely with analytics.
● Experience designing or overseeing launch measurement, brand tracking, or integrated learning agendas at global scale.
● Experience applying AI tools and techniques within market research (for example, synthetic data/respondents, automated analysis, agentic approaches), or strong interest and aptitude in building this capability.
● Experience partnering with centralized research-methods, vendor, and panel-management teams.
● Relevant therapeutic area experience (Immunology, GI) a plus.
● Experience supporting a product launch and the in-market strategy that follows it

.
Additional Information
● 10 – 25% travel depending on business need.
● Lilly may provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role for internal applicants only

title: Tree Crew Leader
description:
Crew Lead Tree Climber

What We Offer

At SavATree, your success is our priority. Here’s how we invest in you:

  • Compensation: Competitive pay based on experience, skill level, and responsibilities. This position pays $35-$38/ hr depending on experience. Qualified candidates may be eligible for a sign-on bonus of up to $2,500.00, determined by experience and credentials at time of hire.

  • Training & Development: Extensive training opportunities, including leadership development and continuing education support in the industry.
  • Tools for Success: Access to industry-leading equipment, climbing gear, and safety-focused crews.
  • Team Environment: Our Tree Care Team works alongside some of the best trained and equipped teams in the industry, with an emphasis on quality and safety.

About SavATree

SavATree was founded 45 years ago with a mission to preserve trees and protect the natural landscapes we all enjoy. Since then, we've grown into a nationwide leader in tree, shrub, and lawn care services.

We're a values-driven organization built on teamwork, integrity, respect, and a shared commitment to the environment. We pride ourselves on offering a collaborative and supportive work culture where your expertise is valued, and your career path is clear. As we like to say: When you work here, you thrive here.

About the Role

As a Tree Climber with SavATree, you’ll be a key member of our General Tree Care Team. This team works on a variety of tree care tasks, including pruning, removals, and cabling. You’ll apply your expertise in climbing, pruning, and safety to ensure the health and beauty of our clients’ landscapes. The Crew Lead position offers additional responsibilities for those who demonstrate leadership qualities and want to guide a team.

In this role, you will:

  • Perform high-quality tree care services, including pruning, removals, and cabling for trees and shrubs
  • Climb trees safely using proper techniques, ropes, saddle, and ladders
  • Operate chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other tree care equipment effectively
  • Apply ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety practices in all tasks
  • Ensure proper pruning cuts and techniques, preserving the health and structure of trees
  • Assist in tree removals and utilize ropes, spikes, and other equipment as needed for safe takedowns
  • Identify hazards and perform safety checks before, during, and after each job
  • Perform aerial rescues if necessary, ensuring safety in high-risk situations
  • Maintain strong communication with team members and clients, ensuring excellent service and safety at all times
  • Take ownership of your role, contributing to a positive, safety-focused team culture

What We’re Looking For

What is Essential:

  • Valid U.S. driver’s license (CDL is preferred)
  • Authorization to work legally in the U.S.
  • Passion for working outdoors and commitment to environmental stewardship

Experience:

  • Proficient in proper pruning techniques for large shade trees and ornamentals
  • Strong knowledge of tree and shrub species, including their characteristics
  • Comfortable climbing without spurs
  • Skilled in adhering to tree care safety standards
  • Experienced with chainsaws, aerial lifts (bucket trucks), and other essential tree care equipment

Technical Knowledge:

  • Expertise in proper pruning cuts, branch collars, and chainsaw operations (for trees up to 50 feet)
  • Familiarity with ANSI A300 Pruning Standards and ANSI Z safety guidelines
  • Ability to perform aerial rescues and apply various climbing techniques
  • Comfortable working with a diverse range of tree species, including Oaks, Maples, Hemlocks, Pines, and more

Physical Requirements:

  • Must be able to lift and move up to 50 pounds frequently
  • Ability to safely perform climbing and aerial work in varying conditions
  • Experience with tree removal, including knowing when to use ropes or spikes for safe takedown

· This job requires physical stamina to meet the demands of climbing, lifting, and performing tasks outdoors. You’ll frequently lift and move heavy equipment and must be comfortable working in a variety of weather conditions.

Equal OpportunityAt SavATree, we believe in fostering a supportive environment where you can grow and succeed. We offer you the opportunity to advance your career and become an industry expert while working with a team that values both individual and collective success.

SavATree is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a Drug-Free Workplace.
